# Icon

`ui.icon` · parts: `Icon` · elements: `<span>`

## Purpose

Icon is a sized frame for a consumer-supplied glyph (svg, sprite, font).
No registry: the glyph is the children/slot. Decorative unless Label is set.

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
- Put a Lucide icon inside (`<Icon size="sm"><Save /></Icon>`; inline Lucide SVG in server template engines).
- Without `label` the icon is decorative (`aria-hidden`); with `label` it gets `role="img"` + `aria-label`.
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

Icon renders span[data-slot=icon]; Label switches to role=img + aria-label.

## Props

| Canonical (templ, Jinja2) | React / Solid | HTML (Svelte, Vue, WC) | Type | Default | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Size` | `size` | `size` | `string` | — | variant | size token: xs, sm, md, lg, xl (default sm) |
| `Label` | `label` | `label` | `string` | — | prop | accessible name; omitted = decorative (aria-hidden) |

Also accepts: `class` (`className` in React), extra attributes (rest props in UI frameworks, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins), children.

## Variants

Base classes: `inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center`

**Size** (recipe key `size`, default `sm`):

| Value | Classes |
| --- | --- |
| `xs` | `size-3` |
| `sm` | `size-4` |
| `md` | `size-5` |
| `lg` | `size-6` |
| `xl` | `size-8` |

## Children

Accepts children (default slot / `children` / `{ children... }` / trusted HTML string in Twig, Latte, Jinja2 — see [runtimes](../runtimes/)). Void tags selected via `tag` render no children.

## ARIA

- Computed/forwarded: `aria-hidden`, `role`, `aria-label` (omitted when empty).

## Classes escape hatch

Compose the part's classes without rendering it (custom root element, no asChild outside React):

| Runtime | Helper |
| --- | --- |
| React / Solid / Vue / Svelte / WC | `iconClasses({ ... })` from `icon/icon.shared.ts` |
| templ | `icon.IconClasses(icon.IconProps{...})` |
| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('iconClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::iconClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `icon_classes(p)` |

## Rendered DOM per state

Canonical renderer output (children = `Content`); all 9 runtimes are parity-tested to produce this DOM.

| State | Props | HTML |
| --- | --- | --- |
| defaults | — | `<span data-slot="icon" class="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center size-4" aria-hidden="true">Content</span>` |
| labelled | `{"Label":"Search","Size":"lg"}` | `<span data-slot="icon" class="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center size-6" role="img" aria-label="Search">Content</span>` |
| xl | `{"Size":"xl","Class":"text-primary"}` | `<span data-slot="icon" class="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center size-8 text-primary" aria-hidden="true">Content</span>` |

## Usage

Fixture `labelled` (`{"Label":"Search","Size":"lg"}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<span data-slot="icon" class="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center size-6" role="img" aria-label="Search">Content</span>
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx
import { Icon } from "./ui/icon/icon";

<Icon label="Search" size="lg">Content</Icon>
```

**Vue 3** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/vue.md))

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Icon from "./ui/icon/Icon.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Icon label="Search" size="lg">Content</Icon>
</template>
```

**Svelte 5** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/svelte.md))

```svelte

  import Icon from "./ui/icon/Icon.svelte";
</script>

<Icon label="Search" size="lg">Content</Icon>
```

**SolidJS** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/solid.md))

```tsx
<Icon label="Search" size="lg">Content</Icon>
```

**Web Components** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/webcomponent.md))

```ts

document.body.append(renderIcon({ label: "Search", size: "lg" }, "Content"));
```

**Go templ** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/templ.md))

```templ

@icon.Icon(icon.IconProps{Label: "Search", Size: "lg"}) {

```

